verdicts.reason: A: the missing-asset grey box is blown up into the largest element in the middle-left, with fine print packed under it; the logo is tiny; 'SOLSTICE PRESENTS' drops to the very bottom, below its own headline; and the RSVP CTA is now a pill the same size as the badges. B: the text stack is jammed together with no leading and has mixed left/centre alignment (Saturday is left-aligned, the rest centred); a dot covers the 'I' in the SOLSTICE wordmark; 'SOLSTICE PRESENTS' again sits below everything and touches the button row; and the CTA has no more weight than the badges. B is slightly less bad because it keeps the placeholder small and has a single clear left-to-right banner row.
